body:
Built a real, general N-joint forward-kinematics + mesh-skinning module (GOLDENBAND src/gpose.h/.c) to close the gap where SHANKPIT's gband_mesh_rig.c was hardcoded to Tyler's own 5-joint rig. Confirmed the founder's own imported Mannequin_F.glb mesh+skeleton and UAL2_Standard_RM mocap clip share the exact same 65-joint skeleton. Vendored gpose.c/gseq.c into SHANKPIT, wrote gband_skel_npc.c/.h as a sibling renderer supporting arbitrary meshes/clips, wired one static NPC spawn in SCENE_VOXWORLD reusing Tyler's own shader with a dedicated larger VBO. 4 real FK+skinning unit tests pass in GOLDENBAND (hand-derived 2-joint rotation case). make lobby builds clean. Full visual confirmation blocked by this sandbox's pre-existing headless GL extension-loading limitation (same one that already disables Tyler's own mesh here), not a regression. Commits: GOLDENBAND de2de96, SHANKPIT 799ad7d.

⚓ ☃
title: General-skeleton NPC rendering via GOLDENBAND gpose.c
